topic: Word of the day for the office: "bandwidth"

script.title: Word of the day: bandwidth

lines.text: Ah, bandwidth means time and energy to take on more work.
Do you have the bandwidth to help on Friday?
Kit's tip: no bandwidth is a polite way to say I'm too busy.
Look up any word on lexkite.com
